facts.text: Resort guests have access to The Ritz-Carlton Beach Club, three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the Sarasota resort have access to our exclusive Beach Club located three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.

facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs hourly between the resort and the Beach Club, starting daily at 9 a.m.
facts.excerpt: A complimentary shuttle runs hourly between the resort and the club beginning daily at 9 a.m.

facts.text: The Beach Club has a zero-entry outdoor pool that is heated year-round.
facts.excerpt: Spend a day under the sun in our zero-entry outdoor pool, heated year-round for guest comfort.

facts.text: Ridley's Porch, the Beach Club restaurant, is named for the rare Kemp's ridley sea turtles that frequent the shore.
facts.excerpt: Named for the rare Kemp’s ridley sea turtles that frequent our shores

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club course was designed by Tom Fazio and is 13 miles from the resort, at Lakewood Ranch.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Tom Fazio, the Sarasota golf course resides 13 miles away from the resort at Lakewood Ranch.

facts.text: Access to the golf club is available exclusively to resort guests and members.
facts.excerpt: Access to The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club is available exclusively to resort guests and members.

facts.text: Jack Dusty is a waterfront seafood restaurant with local ingredients, craft microbrews and cocktails, and downtown marina views.
facts.excerpt: this signature waterfront seafood restaurant in Sarasota showcases fresh local ingredients, craft microbrews and cocktails, with downtown marina views.

facts.text: Jack Dusty received a 2025 OpenTable Diners' Choice Award.
facts.excerpt: 2025 OpenTable Diners' Choice Award - Jack Dusty

facts.text: Rufa serves cocktails and shareables with sunset views of Sarasota Bay.
facts.excerpt: Rufa elevates the senses with imaginative cocktails, shareables and breathtaking sunset views of Sarasota Bay.

facts.text: The Lido Key Tiki Bar is an open-air tiki hut next to the Beach Club and a Lido Beach public access point.
facts.excerpt: The Tiki Bar is located adjacent to The Ritz-Carlton Beach Club and a Lido Beach public access point.

facts.text: The spa's wellness facilities include a jacuzzi, steam and dry saunas, and a waterfront relaxation terrace.
facts.excerpt: The wellness facilities here include a jacuzzi, state-of-the-art gym, steam and dry saunas, a waterfront relaxation terrace

facts.text: The spa's signature treatment combines a full-body massage, exfoliation and a mineral-rich seaweed soak.
facts.excerpt: Calm your senses with the Spa’s signature treatment, featuring a full-body massage, exfoliation and mineral-rich seaweed soak

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have private balconies and marble-trimmed bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Drink in sweeping Florida views from your private balcony, retreat to the marble-trimmed bathroom for a spa-like escape

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has expansive windows and private balconies with panoramic views of the Bay and marina.
facts.excerpt: This hotel suite's expansive windows and private balconies offer panoramic views of the Bay and marina.

facts.text: The resort sits in the heart of an urban downtown, near the beach.
facts.excerpt: Guests will experience resort living in the heart of an urban downtown at our luxury Sarasota hotel near the beach.

facts.text: Club Level access is a paid premium and is not included in general room bookings.
facts.excerpt: The Club Level is a premium experience that requires a paid premium. Access is not included in general room bookings.
